selected_editorial_cases.headline: Nvidia launches Open Agent Safety Platform for autonomous AI agents

editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.new_development: Nvidia moved from warning about agent risk to shipping an explicit containment and monitoring platform on September 28, 2026.
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.affected_listener: Enterprise AI teams, security buyers, and developers building autonomous agents are affected because the launch offers a new control layer to evaluate or adopt.
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.why_today: It is the day’s clearest major product-security development, with direct implications for how AI agents are tested, contained, and governed.
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.distinct_question: Can AI agents be technically constrained at the infrastructure layer rather than only by prompts and policy?
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.new_since_prior_coverage: No prior match in the provided history; this is a new product release, not just a follow-up quote or republished concern.
editorial_analysis_not_verified_facts.practical_payoff: Listeners should watch whether other infrastructure vendors and AI labs adopt similar control-plane safety features, because that will shape near-term enterprise procurement and deployment standards.
